summary: EO-002 Refinements (R1-R8) Enterprise Knowledge Center — fully validated end-to-end. Backend: 17/17 pytest passed on /api/founder/knowledge/{access,tree,doc,search,registry,review,inspector/{id},architecture}. /access returns is_founder:true for founder and false for admin. /tree returns 184 documents (>150) with status_counts {Active:33, Review:132, Draft:18, Archived:1}, categories ordered, every doc carries health{score 0-100} + quality 0-100 + status ∈ {Active,Review,Draft,Archived} + version + author. /doc?path=memory/prompts/SYSTEM_ZERO.md → meta.status=Active, health breakdown (referenced/implementation/evidence/completeness), gate.checks {naming_consistency, versioning, referenced_by_code, duplicate_detection, not_pending, truth_engine_validation} with quality_score + passed, content markdown, relationships depends_on/used_by with evidence. Path traversal (memory/../../etc/passwd) → 404 (no file leak). /search?q=truth returns documents (snippet, occurrences, status) + registry_nodes. /registry: 46 nodes / 44 edges + stats.{edges_by_status, nodes_by_type}. /review returns all 8 arrays (pending_verbatim, drafts, needs_review, duplicates, broken_relations, activation_suggestions, cleanup_suggestions, top_priorities); DRAFT_TOKENS (GRAND_STRATEGY/EVOLUTION_ENGINE/EXPONENTIAL_GROWTH/SCALING_PHASE) unreferenced correctly land in drafts. /inspector/ceo.enterprise_status → engine+api+prompt resolved as nodes + dependencies[] carrying source_name/target_name; unknown widget → 404. /architecture 200 for founder, 403 for admin. 401 for unauth on /tree. Frontend as Founder on /admin/knowledge-center: IDE 3-panel layout renders (kc-categories left · kc-doc-list center · kc-inspector-empty→kc-inspector right); status counts line matches API ('184 documente · 33 Active · 132 Review · 18 Draft · 1 Archived'). Clicking a doc opens Inspector with kc-doc-title, kc-doc-meta, kc-doc-health (4 HealthBars + score %), Quality Gate PASSED/REVIEW label, kc-doc-content markdown rendered, kc-timeline recent activity chips. Search (kc-search-input + kc-search-btn) opens kc-search-results with clickable docs; kc-search-clear removes results. kc-tab-map → registry-graph mounts with 47 rendered node buttons in colored columns; clicking a node opens rg-node-panel with rg-node-name + relations list; clicking a relation → rg-edge-detail with Evidență/Confidence/Status; rg-zoom-in scales the map (scale(1) → scale(1.3)); rg-view-matrix renders 44 filled clickable cells that open rg-edge-detail; rg-zoom-out/rg-center/rg-fullscreen present. kc-tab-review → kc-review + kc-review-priorities chips + all 6 sections present ('În așteptarea', 'Draft', 'review', 'Duplicate', 'activare', 'curățenie') with 160 clickable doc buttons. Deep-link /admin/knowledge-center?doc=memory/prompts/SYSTEM_ZERO.md auto-opens inspector with title 'PROPMANAGE — SYSTEM ZERO · THE ENTERPRISE PRIME DIRECTIVE (VERSION 1.0)'. Security: admin@propmanage.io on /admin/knowledge-center → kc-denied only (no kc-doc-list); /admin/explorer → explorer-denied; /admin/architecture → arch-denied. Regression: 3 inspector-btn's on /admin/ceo-briefing for Founder, drawer opens with widget resolved (Status Enterprise + Enterprise Score, Dependențe count 7).

issues: When a document has 0 Referenced+0 Implementation+0 Evidence but 20/20 Completitudine, the header score renders in red '20%' while gate PASSED — visually confusing (red % next to green PASSED). Consider a small caption 'Health measures reach, not correctness'.
rg-stats shows edge-legend inline with counts and can wrap awkwardly at ~1280px viewport; on desktop 1920 it's fine. Consider a separate legend row below stats on <1400px.
Still intercepts first click on freshly opened routes — must page.click('text=Refuz') after each page.goto (previously flagged iter130/131).

critical_code_review_comments: KnowledgeCenter.jsx L114 — Quality Gate 'critical_failed.join' will explode if backend ever returns null; add optional chaining or default '[]' to guard against schema drift.

KnowledgeCenter.jsx L74-79 InspectorPane — axios call has no cleanup/AbortController; rapid doc switching can race-condition setData with an older response (last-write-wins is not guaranteed on slow networks). Same pattern flagged for InspectorButton in iter131.
RegistryGraph.jsx L77-79 — no error state: if /registry returns 403/500, .catch(() => {}) leaves the component in permanent Loader2 with no user feedback. Add an error UI or retry.
RegistryGraph.jsx L119-121 fullscreen — no exit-fullscreen keyboard handler nor visual close hint; ESC works via browser but the button label doesn't toggle between Enter/Exit.

knowledge_center.py L276 — /doc rebuilds title_counts by iterating ALL docs on every single /doc call (O(N) file reads per request). At 184 docs the endpoint takes ~1s per request. Consider memoizing title_counts (LRU with mtime-based invalidation) or precomputing at /tree time and passing via a lightweight cache.
knowledge_center.py L253+346 — same _doc_meta computation is repeated in /tree and /review for identical file set; extract a module-level cached loader keyed on directory mtime.
knowledge_center.py L82-84 — _require_owner raises 403 with a Romanian message; consider adding a machine-readable code ('founder_only') in the detail dict for frontend switch cases.

OWNER_EMAILS parsing L22 — reads env at import; a change to OWNER_EMAIL requires a full backend restart (already documented convention, but a periodic refresh or a /admin/reload-owners endpoint would help ops).
seed_data_creation: None. Read-only — /app/backend/data/{enterprise_registry.json, widget_inspector.json, architecture_blocks.json} and /app/memory + /app/docs *.md files are the truth source.
context_for_next_testing_agent: IDE 3-panel Knowledge Center, Lifecycle (R2/R3), Health Score (R4), IDE layout (R5), Registry Graph v2 with zoom+matrix+clickable edges (R1/R6), Founder Review (R7), Quality Gate (R8) — all stable. Backend counts observed: 184 docs total (33 Active / 132 Review / 18 Draft / 1 Archived); registry 46 nodes / 44 edges. When testing the Map tab, the SVG scale-transform is on a nested div, not the SVG itself — read transform via document.querySelector('[style*="scale("]'). Matrix has exactly 44 non-disabled cells matching edges. Deep-link ?doc=… auto-opens inspector even when combined with hash-router navigations. Founder Review's 'Draft-uri' section is currently populated (18 docs) — a regression test could pin GRAND_STRATEGY presence to detect lifecycle drift.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. All EO-002 R1-R8 quality gates pass.
